# API & Contracts Checklist: Leiden Algorithm

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, and consistency of the **API and contract specifications** (`contracts/library-api.md`, `contracts/cli-schema.md`, `contracts/tui-events.md`) — i.e., the public surface area and inter-crate boundaries — before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Library API Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 — Are all `pub` items in `data-model.md §1` enumerated in `contracts/library-api.md` (or vice versa), or is there drift between the data model and the public-API contract? [Completeness, Data Model §1, Library API §1]
- [ ] CHK002 — Are the trait bounds on every public generic (`Id: NodeId`, `I: IntoIterator<Item = Edge<Id>>`) explicitly stated in the contract, including what happens when a caller violates them at compile time? [Clarity, Library API §1, §3]
- [ ] CHK003 — Are the visible-from-root re-exports (`pub use …` in §1) sufficient to satisfy FR-006 ("library API sufficient to load, run, retrieve partition, retrieve quality, without exposing internal mutable state") — i.e., does no consumer need to reach into private modules? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, Library API §1]
- [ ] CHK004 — Is the determinism contract for `CsrGraph::from_edges` ("nodes numbered in first-seen order") quantified — i.e., does it specify how parallel first-seen ties are resolved and what stability guarantee holds when edges are passed in a `HashMap`-derived iterator? [Clarity, Library API §3, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 — Are the validation triggers for `from_edges` (negative weight, non-finite weight, self-loop, empty input) listed exhaustively, or is "malformed input" left undefined? [Completeness, Library API §3, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 — Is `LeidenParameters::validate`'s exact contract specified — i.e., does it return early on the first violation, collect all violations, or panic on internal inconsistency? [Clarity, Library API §4, Spec §FR-003, §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK007 — Are `Default` semantics for `LeidenParameters` consistent with the spec's stated defaults (γ = 1.0, seed = None / unspecified, iteration_cap = 10) — and is any divergence between `Default::default()` and "what the spec calls default" documented? [Consistency, Library API §4, Spec §FR-003, §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK008 — Is the contract for `Partition` accessor methods (`community_of`, `move_node`, `renumber`, `is_refinement_of`) specified in terms of pre/post-conditions, or only by signature? [Clarity, Data Model §1.4, Library API — note: `Partition` is re-exported but its methods are not enumerated in library-api.md]
- [ ] CHK009 — Is `MoveComponents` documented as public (re-exported) but its construction site and invariants undefined in the contract — i.e., is it a true public type or a leaky internal detail? [Gap, Data Model §1.7, Library API §1]

## Library API Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 — Is the `RunResult.partition` ordering rule ("sorted by Id's natural ordering, or by Hash collision order for non-Ord ids") stated as a stable contract, or as a best-effort note — and is "Hash collision order" defined? [Ambiguity, Library API §7]
- [ ] CHK011 — Is the contract for `with_event_sink` precise about: back-pressure behavior (blocking, dropping, erroring on full channel), ordering guarantees relative to `tracing` emission, and what happens if the sink is dropped mid-run? [Gap, Library API §6, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK012 — Is the relationship between `tracing` event emission and `mpsc::Sender<LeidenEvent>` emission specified — i.e., is the channel strictly an additional sink, or can one be enabled without the other? [Clarity, Library API §6, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 — Is `QualityFunction::delta_move`'s contract documented for what happens when `target_community == current_community` (zero delta? undefined?), or is the caller assumed to never call it in that case? [Clarity, Library API §5, Data Model §1.6]
- [ ] CHK014 — Are the `Debug` requirements on every public type (`#[derive(Debug)]` per Constitution §IV) called out in the contract as a public-API guarantee, or only as an implementation detail? [Clarity, Library API — entire doc, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK015 — Is the lifetime story of borrow-based accessors (`neighbours_of`, `weights_of`) documented with explicit lifetime annotations, or is the caller expected to infer `&self -> &[u32]` from Rust conventions? [Clarity, Library API §3]

## Library API Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 — Do error variants documented in `library-api.md` match the `LeidenError` enum in `data-model.md §1.11` exactly (variant names, fields, error messages)? [Consistency, Library API §8, Data Model §1.11]
- [ ] CHK017 — Are validation rules consistent across the contract — i.e., does `from_edges` reject self-loops and the parameters validate γ, but neither overlaps in error type with the other? [Consistency, Library API §3, §4, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK018 — Does the contract for `Leiden::run` (§2) list exactly the `LeidenError` variants it can return, or are there implicit delegations from `CsrGraph` left undocumented? [Completeness, Library API §2, §3]
- [ ] CHK019 — Are event-emission rules consistent between FR-010 (every major phase) and `LeidenEvent` variants in `data-model.md §1.8` (9 variants listed — does each map to exactly one phase?)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §1.8]
- [ ] CHK020 — Does `Modularity`'s `pub gamma: f64` field expose a value that the orchestrator is supposed to derive from `LeidenParameters`, or is it separately constructible and risk-divergent? [Ambiguity, Library API §5, Data Model §1.6]

## CLI Contract Completeness

- [ ] CHK021 — Are all CLI flags enumerated in `contracts/cli-schema.md §2` traceable to a spec FR or US, or are there unspecified flags (e.g., `--log-file` mentioned in research §2.3 but not clearly listed in cli-schema)? [Traceability, CLI Schema §2, Research §2.3]
- [ ] CHK022 — Is the JSON output schema in `cli-schema.md` byte-exact identical to the `PartitionOutput` struct in `data-model.md §3.2` — including field order, optionality, and naming (snake_case vs camelCase)? [Consistency, CLI Schema, Data Model §3.2, Spec §FR-007b]
- [ ] CHK023 — Is the input-format dispatch algorithm (extension hint + first-non-whitespace byte sniff) specified with explicit behavior for: empty file, file that begins with a BOM, binary input, and content larger than the 4 KiB peek buffer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a, Research §3.3]
- [ ] CHK024 — Are all `CliError` variants in `data-model.md §3.3` documented in `cli-schema.md` with user-facing remediation guidance, or only with raw error messages? [Completeness, CLI Schema, Data Model §3.3]
- [ ] CHK025 — Is the behavior specified for invalid combinations — e.g., `--format text` together with `--json-schema`, or mutually-exclusive flags that don't have a declared conflict? [Gap, Spec §FR-007b]
- [ ] CHK026 — Are exit-code mappings defined for each `CliError` variant (e.g., is `ParseFieldCount` exit 2 and `Leiden::EmptyGraph` exit 0 because the run succeeded?), or are exit codes left to implementation? [Gap, Spec §US-3 acceptance scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK027 — Is the stdin-pipe contract specified — i.e., does `leiden-cli read from a pipe` dispatch to the same parser as `leiden-cli read from path`, and what file-path label appears in error messages when reading from stdin? [Gap, Research §3.4, Spec §FR-007a]

## CLI Contract Clarity

- [ ] CHK028 — Is the default separator for the edge-list format (tab/comma) explicitly stated with priority rules and how a user overrides it, or left ambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a]
- [ ] CHK029 — Is the `# nodes=N` header semantics specified — i.e., is `N` a declaration that creates N nodes, a count-assertion that must match the parsed edges, or just metadata? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a]
- [ ] CHK030 — Is the JSON adjacency document schema (`AdjacencyDoc` in `data-model.md §3.1`) documented with required vs optional fields, and what happens if `nodes` and `edges` reference ids not in `nodes`? [Clarity, Data Model §3.1, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK031 — Are all emitted events for the CLI path (FR-010) mapped to specific `tracing` macros with structured fields, or only listed by intent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Research §2.3]

## TUI Contract Completeness

- [ ] CHK032 — Are all `LeidenEvent` variants from `data-model.md §1.8` mapped to a TUI render action in `contracts/tui-events.md`, or are some variants observed but not rendered? [Completeness, TUI Events, Data Model §1.8]
- [ ] CHK033 — Is the `AppState` enum (`data-model.md §3.4`) consistent with the event transitions in `tui-events.md` — i.e., does every event map to a documented state transition? [Consistency, Data Model §3.4, TUI Events]
- [ ] CHK034 — Is the `LogPaneLayer` (the custom `tracing_subscriber::Layer<S>` for in-TUI log scrolling) specified with explicit ring-buffer size, overflow policy, and format function — or only mentioned in research? [Clarity, TUI Events, Research §2.3]
- [ ] CHK035 — Are all key bindings (`q`/`r`/`l`/`g`/`s`/`?` per research §2.4) documented in `tui-events.md` with their state preconditions (e.g., `r` only valid in `Done` or `Error` state)? [Completeness, TUI Events, Research §2.4]
- [ ] CHK036 — Is the snapshot-testing strategy (`ratatui::backend::TestBackend`) specified with coverage matrix — which `AppState` × `selected_community` × `show_log` × `show_graph` combinations have fixtures? [Gap, Quickstart §6, Plan §Testing]
- [ ] CHK037 — Is the panic-recovery behavior specified — i.e., what happens to the TUI state machine if `ratatui::restore()` fails or if the worker thread panics? [Gap, TUI Events, Constitution §VI]

## TUI Contract Clarity

- [ ] CHK038 — Is the channel between worker and renderer specified as bounded or unbounded, and what is the exact back-pressure policy when full? [Clarity, TUI Events, Library API §6]
- [ ] CHK039 — Is the render-loop tick interval documented — i.e., how often does the TUI drain the channel, and is there a defined idle-vs-active frame rate? [Gap, TUI Events, Research §2.4]
- [ ] CHK040 — Is the layout of the three panes (community list, graph view, log pane) specified with sizing rules — fixed heights? proportional splits? hideable panes? — or only listed by name? [Gap, TUI Events, Research §2.4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK041 — Is SC-001 ("≤ 5 s for a 100-node, 500-edge fixture") measurable from the public API alone, or does it require benchmark-only access? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Library API]
- [ ] CHK042 — Is SC-002 ("≥ 90% match under documented tie-breaking") testable deterministically — i.e., is there a reference fixture suite with published tie-break rules? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK043 — Is SC-003 (1000 random graphs property test) specified with a documented RNG strategy so that the property test itself is reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK044 — Is SC-004 ("public API exposes exactly the capabilities described in FR-006") enforceable via a lint or test, or is it a subjective reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK045 — Is SC-005 (every malformed input produces a structured error + non-zero exit code) testable from the public CLI alone, or does it require internal-error introspection? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Versioning & Stability

- [ ] CHK046 — Is the stability contract in `library-api.md §9` specific about which items are semver-stable vs which are best-effort — e.g., is `partition` ordering a stability guarantee or an implementation detail? [Clarity, Library API §9]
- [ ] CHK047 — Are deprecation policy and MSRV-bump policy stated for the v1 public surface, or only implicit in the governance document? [Gap, Library API §9, Constitution §VII]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK048 — Are the performance budgets (SC-001, "cache-friendly CSR", "O(|E|) per partition") expressed as measurable contracts in the API doc, or only as implementation targets in research? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Research §1.4]
- [ ] CHK049 — Is the channel-throughput requirement on the TUI worker→renderer path quantified — i.e., events/sec the system must sustain without back-pressure dropping? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, TUI Events]
- [ ] CHK050 — Is the memory ceiling stated as an API contract (≤ ~100k nodes / ~1M edges per Assumptions), or only as an assumption-level guidance? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK051 — Are all external crates referenced in any contract (`thiserror`, `tracing`, `clap`, `serde`, `serde_json`, `ratatui`, `crossterm`, `proptest`, `criterion`, `rand`, `color-eyre`, `tracing-subscriber`) listed with pinned version ranges in one place, or scattered across contracts/research? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, Library API / CLI / TUI contracts]
- [ ] CHK052 — Is the assumption "Rust stable, edition 2024" stated as an API contract (i.e., users get a hard MSRV), or only as a build-time fact? [Gap, Library API §9, Constitution Additional Constraints]
- [ ] CHK053 — Is the determinism assumption ("seed: None is fully deterministic by lowest-id tie-break") stated as a stability contract, or as a behavior detail that may change in v2? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Library API §4]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK054 — Is the conflict between `CsrGraph::from_edges` rejection of self-loops (per FR-008 / contract §3) and the algorithm's "self-loops contribute once to kᵢ and e_c" reasoning (research §1.4) resolved — i.e., is the rejection at parser boundary or library boundary, and is the error surfaced before the algorithm ever sees the edge? [Conflict, Spec §FR-008, Research §1.4]
- [ ] CHK055 — Is the conflict between "deterministic but unspecified seed" (Assumptions) and "byte-identical output partitions under fixed seed" (FR-004) resolved at the contract level — i.e., does the default `seed = None` produce the same partition as `seed = Some(0)`? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK056 — Is the conflict between `CsrGraph::from_edges` returning `LeidenError::EmptyGraph` for zero-edges AND the algorithm's separate `TerminationReason::DegenerateInput` for zero-edge runs documented — i.e., does `from_edges` ever succeed on an empty input, or does the empty case live entirely in `Leiden::run`? [Conflict, Data Model §1.3 + §1.11, Spec §US-1 acceptance scenario 3]
- [ ] CHK057 — Is the term "community" used consistently across all three contracts with the same definition (non-empty subset, internally connected, mutually disjoint), or do data-model §1.4 and contracts diverge? [Consistency, Data Model §1.4, Library API §7, CLI Schema]

## Traceability

- [ ] CHK058 — Does every section in `contracts/library-api.md`, `contracts/cli-schema.md`, and `contracts/tui-events.md` reference at least one FR, US, or data-model section, or are any sections orphan? [Traceability, All Contracts]
- [ ] CHK059 — Is the relationship between FR-006 ("public library API sufficient to load, run, retrieve partition, retrieve quality") and the four re-export groups in `library-api.md §1` made explicit — i.e., does each FR-006 capability map to exactly one re-export? [Traceability, Spec §FR-006, Library API §1]
- [ ] CHK060 — Are the snapshot/benchmark/property tests promised in `quickstart.md` traceable to the corresponding SC in the spec (SC-001..SC-005)? [Traceability, Quickstart, Spec §SC-001..§SC-005]
- [ ] CHK061 — Is the `clap` derive struct that backs the CLI flags specified in `cli-schema.md §2` rather than only in research — i.e., is the user-facing contract the schema doc or the source? [Traceability, CLI Schema §2, Research §3]
